title.narrative: Feed the Future Egypt Rural Agribusiness Strengthening (ERAS)

description.narrative: (Egypt): USAID's Feed the Future Egypt Rural Agribusiness Strengthening activity's primary goal is to increase the incomes of small farmers in Upper Egypt and the Nile Delta by building their capacity to respond to demand from domestic and international buyers and fully meet market requirements. This agricultural activity strengthens market linkages and improves post-harvest handling and storage systems, thereby increasing the productivity of farmers and food processors and building partnerships between farmers, associations, cooperatives, and agribusinesses. USAID's agricultural activity is helping small farmers and agribusinesses gain access to finance and increases adherence to food safety practices. By addressing these two key inputs, this activity contributes to improved nutritional outcomes for women and children. Key components of the activity include: 1) strengthening sustainable domestic and international market linkages, 2) improving post-harvest handling and storage, 3) increasing productivity of small farmers and food processors, and 4) improving nutritional status of women and children. Over the course of five years, this activity is anticipated to increase the average incomes of 120,000 small farmers, and create 12,000 sustainable full time equivalent jobs in agribusiness. This activity targets agricultural technical school graduates, landless laborers, women, unemployed youth, and entrepreneurs for employment opportunities by implementing programs that build their capacity to integrate into high-value commercial horticulture markets.
